findings.evidence: return [value for value in left if value in right]
findings.summary: Performing membership checks using 'if value in right' on a list takes O(len(right)) per check, leading to O(len(left) * len(right)) overall time complexity.
findings.suggested_action: Convert 'right' to a set (e.g. right_set = set(right)) before the list comprehension to achieve O(1) average-time lookups.
